title: Dead Mall Security
subject: a night security guard in a mall with no tenants
caption: Rage rap. Bitcrushed detuned lead synth carrying the whole melody, 808 driven into clipping on purpose, sparse hi-hats with long gaps, no snare fills, deliberate mp3 artifacting on the tails. Fast deadpan male rap, flat affect, screamed ad-libs mixed as loud as the lead vocal, hard autotune used texturally on the hook only. 162 BPM, F sharp minor. Flat, dissociated, bored rather than angry. No trap hi-hat rolls, no clean 808 slides, no boom bap, no melodic trap.
lyrics:
[Intro - bitcrushed synth stab]

[Verse 1 - rapped, fast]
Guard booth light on, nobody guarding nothing
Sears been gone six years, they still wax the floor
Push the cart out front for the cameras, cart got no wheels
I clock in at nine, I dissolve at ten

[Hook - screamed ad-libs layered]
Nothing in the bag, nothing in the bag
Walk it to the car like it's heavy
Nothing in the bag

[Verse 2 - rapped]
Mom calls, I let it ring, call her back from the same chair
Fountain's dry, they filled it with those white rocks
Kid on a scooter doing laps around the pretzel place
I'd tell him to slow down but I'd have to stand up

[Hook - screamed ad-libs layered]
Nothing in the bag, nothing in the bag
Walk it to the car like it's expensive
Nothing in the bag

[Outro - 808 clipping]
[Song ends abruptly]
